audience: church and ministry staff who plan services, schedule volunteers and run small groups

useCases.title: Check who is scheduled for a service
useCases.text: List the plans of a service type. Read the team members scheduled on one plan, with their team position and status.

useCases.title: Read the order of a service
useCases.text: Open one plan to read its title, dates and series. List its items in order, such as songs, readings and media.

useCases.title: Find a song in the library
useCases.text: Search the song library by title. Open one song to read its author, CCLI number and key.

useCases.title: Read a People list such as volunteers
useCases.text: List the People lists, such as volunteers or new members. List the people in one list, a page at a time.

useCases.title: Review group members and meeting attendance
useCases.text: List the groups, and the members of one group with their roles. List the attendance records of one group meeting.
